events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the music world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of music's most incredible voices. Freddie Mercury's legacy lives on louder than ever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative now as it did then.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of John Lennon's passing in 1980; he would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of John Lennon today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today, born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring genius of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true Starman.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today, born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His music still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today, born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today, born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 60
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! What's your favourite Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today, born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! Still got that smooth voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today, born on January 19, 1946.

angles.name: Jolene Turns 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! What an icon.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today, born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: A Million Love Songs
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! Still got that magic touch.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British singer Billy Ocean, known for 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today, born on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Still making us want to dance.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inducted its first class. Who would be in your dream induction?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That's Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today, born on January 27, 1972.

angles.name: Shine On Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the ever-youthful Mark Owen! What's your favourite Take That era?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their iconic final gig. A moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today, born on January 30, 1951.

angles.name: Against All Odds
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today, born on January 31, 1981.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! What's your go-to JT track?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, with the tragic plane crash that killed Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Never Forgotten
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years after 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today, born on February 6, 1966.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still got those moves.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82

angles.name: One Love, One Heart
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King! A true songwriting genius.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Whitney Houston in 2012; she would have been 64 years old.

angles.name: The Voice Lives On
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston today. Her voice was, and remains, truly unmatched.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since the original Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the world stopped when Take That announced they were splitting. Thankfully, they're back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today, born on February 15, 1959.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36

angles.name: Thinking Out Loud
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today, born on February 25, 1943.

angles.name: My Sweet Lord
angles.copy: Remembering the brilliant George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. His music continues to bring light to the world.
